# University of the People

> Tuition-free, accredited online university offering Associate, Bachelor, and Master's degree programs for working professionals and international students worldwide.

University of the People (UoPeople) is an innovative online institution providing American-accredited degrees without tuition costs. The university serves a global student population across multiple languages and offers flexible, asynchronous learning formats designed for working professionals seeking career advancement and education accessibility.

## Key Topics

- Tuition-Free Education
- Accredited Degrees
- Online University
- MBA (Master of Business Administration)
- MSIT (Master of Science in Information Technology)

## Master's Degree Programs

- [Online Tuition-Free Master's Degree Programs](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-masters): Master's degree program overview including MBA and MSIT options
- [Online Tuition-Free Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA)](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-masters/business-administration): MBA program details, curriculum, and admission requirements
- [Online Tuition-Free Master's Degree in Information Technology (MSIT)](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-masters/information-technology): MSIT program featuring Calculus, Linear Algebra, and database courses
- [Online Tuition-Free Master's Degree in Education (M.Ed.)](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-masters/education): M.Ed. program in Advanced Teaching with asynchronous learning format

## Bachelor's Degree Programs

- [Online Tuition-Free Bachelor's Degree Programs](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-bachelors): Bachelor's degree program overview across Business, CS, and Health Science
- [Online Tuition-Free Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration (BBA)](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-bachelors/business-administration): BBA program with flexible schedule and career preparation focus
- [Online Tuition-Free Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science (BCS)](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-bachelors/computer-science): BCS program covering Java, Python, AI, and software development
- [Online Tuition-Free Bachelor's Degree in Health Science (BHS)](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-bachelors/health-science): BHS program designed for healthcare career advancement and preparation

## Associate's Degree Programs

- [Online Tuition-Free Associate's Degree Programs](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-associates): Associate's degree program overview in Business, CS, and Health Science
- [Online Tuition-Free Associate's Degree in Business Administration](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-associates/business-administration): Associate's Business Administration degree with career preparation pathway
- [Online Tuition-Free Associate's Degree in Computer Science](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-associates/computer-science): Associate's CS degree with programming and software development focus
- [Online Tuition-Free Associate's Degree in Health Science](https://www.uopeople.edu/programs/online-associates/health-science): Associate's Health Science degree with healthcare education and pay-as-you-go
